newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys 25,000/t Oct fuel oil from FAL.
newsitem.headline: India buys 25,000/t Oct fuel oil from FAL.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought by tender 25,000 tonnes of October fuel oil at $12.75 per tonne over Mideast quotes on a cost and freight basis (c-and-f), industry sources said on Monday.
The 180 centistoke, 3.5 percent sulphur grade cargo was sold by FAL Bunkering for delivery between October 15-19 to Goa/Kandla, on the Indian west coast.
In its last last tender for September 16-20 delivery, IOC purchased a total of 50,000 tonnes of fuel oil.
FAL Bunkering sold the first 25,000 tonne cargo at $10.48 premium over Mideast quotes, c-and-f basis for delivery to Goa/Kandla.

The second 25,000 tonne cargo was sold by Swiss trader, Glencore at $7 per tonne over Mideast quotes on a free on board basis Gulf. The cargo was to be delivered to Vizag/Haldia on the Indian east coast.
